overlapHelp.QUEUE: Every trigger creates a run, and runs start one at a time in the order they were queued.
overlapHelp.CONCURRENT: Runs start as soon as they are triggered, up to the maximum below.

overlapScopeHelp.WORKTREE: Counted per worktree, so a run on one worktree never waits for a run on another. Runs that belong to no worktree share a queue of their own.
overlapScopeHelp.GLOBAL: Counted across the whole workflow, so its runs wait for each other no matter which worktree they belong to.

The run itself waits for work already under way before it starts, and its own steps continue normally.

worktreeConcurrencyHelp.EXCLUSIVE: Runs alone after older participating workflows, plans, and sessions finish. New participating work waits until this run completes.
worktreeConcurrencyHelp.NON_EXCLUSIVE: Shares the worktree with other non-exclusive workflows, plans, and sessions, but waits for exclusive work.
worktreeConcurrencyHelp.EXCLUDED: Does not wait in or contribute to the worktree admission lane. Git and worktree steps still serialize when they execute.
